alt.en: An arXiv preprint proposes recording which model ran in which harness, including configuration changes within a run. The saved abstract describes a framework, without establishing deployment or effectiveness.
alt.zh: 一篇 arXiv 预印本提议记录模型及其所用 harness，包括单次运行中的配置变化。保存的摘要介绍了这一框架，但未确立其部署情况或实际效果。
